div.p: Located between Queen and Elizabeth streets, Warburton Lane extends south from Little Bourke Street. It was named pre-1895 after Thomas Warburton, a galvanised iron merchant who traded from this lane. In 2007, Warburton Lane was host to the City of Melbourne's Laneway Commissions art installation 'Chandelier', created by Angela Morgan, Isla Shaw and Kylie Mitchell.
